tooltips.pipeline: Enable multi-stage pipeline. Task goes through multiple AI agents: planning, review, coding, testing
tooltips.planner: Creates a detailed implementation plan from the task description
tooltips.reviewer: Reviews the plan for quality and completeness. Returns for rework if issues found
tooltips.builder: Writes code following the approved plan. Also fixes bugs found in code review
tooltips.codeReview: Reviews written code for bugs, errors, and plan compliance
tooltips.tester: Plans tests based on spec and architecture, writes and runs them
tooltips.consensus: Reviewer can rewrite and improve the plan. Agents negotiate over multiple rounds
tooltips.strict: Reviewer only critiques, does not rewrite the plan
tooltips.secondAgent: When primary agent fails after retries, task is passed to second agent with full context
tooltips.createPr: After all stages pass, automatically create a Pull Request
